Package io.micronaut.python.imports

@NullMarked package io.micronaut.python.imports
Curated Python modules: the PythonImportMapper SPI that gathers the names of several Java packages behind one Python import, and their resolution against a class path.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
Graeme Rocher
  • Class
    Description
    ClassIndex
    The view of the class path a curated module is resolved against.
    ClassIndex.TypeInfo
    What the index knows of a type.
    ClassIndex.TypeKind
    The kinds of types, as Python sees them.
    PythonImportMapper
    Contributes curated Python modules that gather the names of one or more Java packages behind a single import, such as a pyronaut.http module exporting the HTTP annotations, the HTTP types and the static factories of HttpResponse.
    PythonImportMappingException
    Thrown when the curated modules cannot be resolved: a clash no rule decides, or contributions to one module that disagree.
    PythonImportMappings
    The curated Python modules the mappers on a class path contribute, and their resolution against a ClassIndex.
    PythonModuleMapping
    The definition of a curated Python module: the Java sources whose names it exports, in precedence order, and how the names two sources both export are decided.
    PythonModuleMapping.Builder
    Builds a PythonModuleMapping.
    PythonModuleMapping.ClashPolicy
    How the clashes that no explicit preference decides are decided.
    PythonModuleMapping.Source
    A source of the names a curated module exports.
    PythonModuleMapping.Source.Constants
    The constants of a Java type, exported as module attributes under their names: the constants of an enum (HttpStatus.CREATED), or the public static final fields of a class or an interface (MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).
    PythonModuleMapping.Source.JavaPackage
    Every public, top-level type of a Java package that is not internal (not annotated with @Internal), or only those of the given kinds.
    PythonModuleMapping.Source.JavaType
    One Java type, exported under its simple name or an alias.
    PythonModuleMapping.Source.StaticMethods
    The public static methods of a Java type, exported as module functions under their names.
    ResolvedModule
    A curated module resolved against a class path: the names it exports and the targets they stand for.
    ResolvedModule.Clash
    A name more than one source exports for different targets.
    ResolvedModule.Kind
    The kinds of names a curated module exports.
    ResolvedModule.Member
    A name a curated module exports.
